faqs.q: Can HubSpot send new contacts to Google Sheets without Zapier?
faqs.a: Yes, with a workflow on a Professional or Enterprise plan. On a free or Starter plan you need a tool outside HubSpot, such as this automation.

faqs.q: Will it post in Slack without asking me?
faqs.a: No. An automation's post to a Slack channel waits in Needs you until you approve it. The row in your own sheet goes in on its own.

faqs.q: Does it add contacts that already exist in HubSpot?
faqs.a: No. It starts on each new contact from the moment it is live, so older contacts are not added. Export them from HubSpot and paste or drop the file in a sheet if you need them.

faqs.q: What if I want the row to update when a contact changes?
faqs.a: This automation adds a row when a contact is created. For changes, ask Captain for a second automation that updates the row, using Google Sheets' lookup and update actions.

faqs.q: Can it post to a private Slack channel?
faqs.a: Yes, once you invite the Slack app to that channel. Slack only lists private channels the app belongs to.
